checks.name: build-check
checks.cmd: env -u PYTHONPATH python3 build.py >/dev/null && env -u PYTHONPATH python3 check.py && git diff --exit-code --quiet -- '*.html' && git checkout -- assets/cv.pdf

notes: No pytest here, so the test counter is always zero and min_passed stays 0. The weight is carried by check.py (content invariants) plus a holdout per issue that asserts on the built HTML. build.py regenerates assets/cv.pdf with a new timestamp, so the command restores it to keep the tree clean for the factory's dirty check.
